gloss: destination of transmission; recipient; To: address

definitions.gloss: destination of transmission; recipient; To: address
definitions.explanation: The address or party to which an email, fax, or other electronic communication is sent. The label of the To: field on forms and email clients.

examples.japanese: {送信先|そうしんさき}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
{送信先|そうしんさき}の{名前|なまえ}を{間違|まちが}えてメールを{出|だ}してしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally sent the email with the wrong recipient name.

examples.japanese: {個人情報|こじんじょうほう}を{含|ふく}むメールは、{送信先|そうしんさき}が{正|ただ}しいか{必|かなら}ず{確認|かくにん}しよう。
examples.english: For emails containing personal information, always make sure to verify that the recipient is correct.

notes:
Compound of {送信|そうしん} (transmission) + {先|さき} (destination). The 〜{先|さき} suffix forms many "destination/contact" words: {連絡先|れんらくさき} (contact address), {宛先|あてさき} (addressee).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送信先|そうしんさき}を{確認|かくにん}する: to verify the recipient
- {送信先|そうしんさき}を{選|えら}ぶ: to choose the recipient
- {送信先|そうしんさき}{不明|ふめい}: recipient unknown / address not found
- {送信先|そうしんさき}{一覧|いちらん}: list of recipients

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {宛先|あてさき}: addressee — used for postal mail as well as email
- {受信者|じゅしんしゃ}: receiver, recipient — focuses on the person, not the address
- {宛|あて}: addressed to (suffix) — used in formal address lines, e.g. {社長|しゃちょう}{宛|あて}
